categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Changes what the mining interface exposes and fixes concurrency in template management; the ipc guidance explicitly excludes mining interface additions and template logic that do not change IPC infrastructure itself.
categories.rationale: PRs whose subject is what the mining interface exposes or how templates are built are categorized as mining rather than IPC unless they change the underlying IPC infrastructure.

categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies block template handling in `src/node/block_template_manager.*` and the `interfaces::Mining` interface.
categories.rationale: Fixes a data race where concurrent IPC worker threads access `CBlockTemplate` during `submitSolution()`, avoiding potential memory corruption or interface instability for external miners (issue #36515). It also adds `getTotalFees()` so external miners and Stratum v2 clients do not need to repeatedly fetch and sum individual transaction fees across the process boundary.
